name: deck-restyle
description: Restyles a plain Claude Slides draft into one claim per slide and returns a Restyle Log with dense slides split, topic titles rewritten as sentences, bullets replaced by evidence, AI tells removed, and a before and after list per slide. Use for "run deck-restyle", "this deck reads as AI", "make the slides less generic", "fix the plain draft", "too many bullets", "split the dense slides", "one claim per slide", part of the Claude Slides for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
